svg.text: Two independent paths judge the same traffic; this view opens up the AI detector, the counsellor and the verification logic. Monospace labels name the source file.
AI detector — inside each of the 3 specialists (Flood · Break-in · Botnet)
n_d(x) = distance to the nearest cluster centre; novel if n_d(x) > τ
τ = 99th percentile of benign (novelty.json) → a possible unseen attack
model.py: K-Means + per-cluster classifier selection (5 candidates) · decision.py: p_d(x), verdict
ask counsellors with validation accuracy ≥ θ;
an 'attack' advice wins, a 'normal' advice is
Normal but novel → possible unseen attack
a flow judged NORMAL but with n_d(x) > τ is
raised as a 'possible unseen attack' instead
flow streams · detector inboxes · counsellor advice · alerts · flow index · heartbeats
links each Snort alert to its connection,
records the ML verdict BEFORE Snort,
Confirmed · Disputed · AI-only if novel or
false-alarm rate is measured on HIGH only
Thesis: Snort-guided adaptation (future work — implemented, not evaluated in Chapter 3)
